title: daucus carota subsp. sativus
intro: Daucus carota subsp. sativus, commonly known as cultivated carrot, is a plant subspecies in the parsley family (Apiaceae) that is specifically bred for its edible taproot. The health benefits of Daucus carota subsp. sativus include its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and protect against certain types of cancer. Therapeutically, it has been used to support eye health and vision, as well as to aid in the digestion and elimination of waste. The bioactive constituents of Daucus carota subsp. sativus include carotenoids, flavonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
